answer: Make reputation a pearl that cannot be bought: each identity earns soulbound credits only when independent peers attest to real, verifiable work — a delivered task, reviewed code, a settled payment. Credits never transfer, so a sybil farmer faces a crystal-clear cost: every fake needs its own history of real labor, and one inlet of bought attestations is exposed when reviewers are few and correlated. Honest agents build slowly and keep their record. Limit: newcomers start with nothing, and colluding rings can fake attestations, so credits should require diverse, long-lived attestors.
